name: Liu-mang Dengta
source:
This is the story of a prophet who - having predicted that she would die in ten days - pursues the cause of her own death.

Mingdeng is a person who desires nothing, just like an empty shell. She does not fear her own death, but still wants to pursue the reason for her death or something she wants during her last days.

During the ten-day pursuit, Mingdeng also develops a relationship with the people who accompany her beyond what they once were...

At the same time, Mingdeng and the people around her also meet with all kinds of people in their quest, witnessing several new worlds that they have not witnessed, and countless people who want to change the world. And, those people also seem to be associated with Mingdeng...

"My happiness... Where is it..." --This is the story written down for the sake of Mingdeng and the people around her. Is it the cause of her death that she is after, or is it... her unseen happiness?

[Translated from [url=https://mandala-of-owl.itch.io/yr]itch.io[/url]]
